review_description: Luke came out to measure up and explained everything as well as being able to give a conservative roe of 4 years payback. In 3 years it has paid for itself being a $1000/month household on average. In 2013 when we installed we were one of the last to get the $0.50c rebate and so glad we went with Luke from a referral who had 2 systems installed on his city and country properties.
Very happy with whole experience. Answered all questions to satisfaction, quick time for appointment and install, very professional. Would recommend.
